Nashik, India

40‑Bed Multi‑Specialty Hospital

Cardiology, Orthopedics, General Medicine

Book Appointment

About Us

The 40‑bed multi‑specialty hospital in Nashik provides cardiology, orthopaedics and general medicine services. Our mission is to deliver comprehensive, patient‑focused care rooted in compassion, excellence and community service. We are dedicated to serving the local community with a skilled team of specialists.

Our Specialties

  • Cardiology

    Provides diagnosis and treatment of heart conditions for patients of all ages.

  • Orthopedics

    Offers surgical and non‑surgical care for musculoskeletal injuries and disorders.

  • General Medicine

    Delivers comprehensive primary care and preventive health services for the community.

Medical Team

  • Cardiologist

    Provides cardiac care as a board‑certified specialist.

    Cardiologist

  • Orthopedic Surgeon

    Performs musculoskeletal surgeries as a board‑certified orthopedic surgeon.

    Orthopedic Surgeon

  • General Medicine Physician

    Delivers primary care services as a qualified general practitioner.

    General Medicine Physician

  • Emergency Physician

    Handles urgent cases in the emergency department as a certified emergency medicine doctor.

    Emergency Physician

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I get admitted as a patient?

Admission begins with registration at the front desk and presentation of a valid ID and referral, if required.

What are the visiting hours?

Visiting hours are from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily, with a maximum of two visitors per patient.

Does the hospital accept insurance?

Insurance is accepted from major providers; please present your insurance card at registration for verification.

How can I schedule an appointment?

Appointments can be scheduled by calling the hospital’s appointment desk or through the online portal, if available.

What should I do in an emergency?

Emergency cases are triaged immediately at the emergency department; proceed to the main entrance and inform the staff of your condition.

Contact Us

For appointments and inquiries, please get in touch.

Nashik 40‑Bed Multi‑Specialty Hospital
